errors.text_span: wobei die Werte als Index mit 2019 = 100 skaliert sind
errors.evidence: The chart does not state that the y-axis represents an index, nor that 2019=100 is the baseline. This is an interpretation not supported by explicit visual information.
The description fails to mention that the y-axis has no label or units, which is a key objective observation of the figure. Instead, it invents the unit "Ausgabenindex".
The y-axis has no label. Stating it represents an 'Ausgabenindex' (expenditure index) is an interpretation not explicitly shown on the chart.
For the blue line ('Äußere Sicherheit'), the value in 2019 is approximately 94 and it rises slightly to about 95 in 2020. The description incorrectly states that it falls to 93.
For the blue line ('Äußere Sicherheit'), the value in 2023 is approximately 102. It falls to approximately 98 in the year 2024, not 2023.
For the purple line ('Innere Sicherheit'), the value in 2019 is approximately 96 and it rises to 100 in 2020. The description incorrectly states that it falls to 98.
